messages:
rachel: Heads-up for month-close: our usage lag accrual looks understated. Ran the daily usage reconciliation and gap is ~$116,400 for Nov period.

 diego: Oof. How did we measure accrual vs actual? Which report?

 rachel: I compared `usage_ingest` vs `billing_cutoff` using `scripts/usage_lag_report.py`. Query: `select sum(usd_estimated) from usage_ingest where event_time < '2026-11-30' and processed_at > '2026-12-02'` gave 116400 more than what was in billed period.

 maria: That matches a partial ETL delay we had on 11/29 where 8 ingestion workers restarted and backlog grew. We saw a spike in `ingest_queue_depth`.

 acct-bot: Created ticket FIN-5577: "usage-lag-accrual-variance-116400" assigned=rachel.

 diego: For close: we should post an accrual JE to cover the estimate. Draft JE: DR 6300 AccruedUsageExpense 116400 / CR 2100 AccruedRevenue 116400 dated 11/30. Agreed?

 rachel: That looks right. Also need memo referencing root cause (ingest backlog) and link to remediation. I'll attach the usage_lag_report output.

 maria: We'll backfill the missing usage runs to billing in early Dec. Once those items invoice, we'll reverse the accrual. Add a reversing JE note with expected reversal window 12/05-12/10.

 diego: CFO signoff required for accrual > $100k. @cfo can you review?

 cfo: Reviewed. Approve accrual JE for 116,400. Please set reversal condition on realization of billed invoices and document reversal permutations: full, partial, none.

 rachel: JE prepared in NetSuite as draft JE-99123. Memo: "FIN-5577 usage lag accrual due to ingestion worker restarts on 2026-11-29. Reversal when impacted usage invoices post (expected 12/05-12/10)."

 diego: Post JE-99123 in Nov close. Also add a month-close control to run `usage_lag_report.py` and threshold alert >50k.

 maria: I'll add alert to ops monitoring and create a smoke test to detect ingest worker restarts before cutoff.

 acct-bot: FIN-5577 updated: status=approved je=JE-99123 posted_by=diego.

 rachel: Thanks. Closing thread once reversal completes. I'll update FIN-5577 with outcome."
